about: Generated by aileron_vectors.mjs from aileron.html's model; checked by it, and by workbench_tests.cpp against aileron.hpp. Do not edit by hand.

units.pa: dynamic pressure over that aileron's panels
units.alpha_deg: that aileron's panel angle of attack, before the ±30° clamp
units.unbalance_inlb: one aileron's weight about its hinge, trailing edge heavy positive
units.hinge_slope_per_rad: where present, the case's hinge slope in place of the figures'
units.anchor_nm: the model's torque at a rest that lies at a stop; 0 otherwise
units.left_nm: the left aileron's air through the linkage, N·m at the wheel, right positive
units.total_nm: the model's torque at the wheel
units.rim_lb: the same at the grip radius
units.rest_deg: where the torque is zero; 0 and indifferent when nothing turns it
units.rest_counts: drive counts, 13000 at either stop, right positive
units.half_wheel_left_deg: the left aileron at half wheel right, up positive (the differential)
units.x0: the wheel, drive counts right positive; null at the model's rest
units.ceiling: the drive's ceiling, percent: the strongest spring within its margin
units.slope_nm_per_count: the model's secant from its rest to x0

sweep.about: the left aileron's angle from from_deg to to_deg in step_deg steps at pa both sides, the right's at right_alpha_deg (null: the left's), nothing stalled: the wheel's rest (counts, unrounded; null with both sides alike, a tie between the stops), the torque at at_wheel_deg and the drive's (force-exact, 1000 units per N·m) at at_counts, each step; no step may move the rest more than rest_counts nor a torque more than per_pa times pa
